data.trigger: when an acceptance criterion needs a hook to fire on a real dispatch
data.what: a hook registered mid-session never fired
data.why: Claude Code snapshots the hooks block at session start
data.fix: register in session N and verify in session N+1

data.trigger: when editing a frontmatter field on a task file
data.what: a valid YAML form was invisible to the regex reader
data.why: each reader is a single regex over the raw text
data.fix: run the reader regex against the exact string before writing it

data.trigger: when a signature has no break opportunity
data.what: a long unbroken signature widened the card
data.fix: wrap with overflow-wrap anywhere, never ellipsize
